charts.title: TOI-2095 b: orbits around TOI-2095
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-2095's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-2095 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Quintana et al. 2023 (2023AJ....166..195Q), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname QUINTANA_ET_AL__2023): P 17.664872 d

charts.title: TOI-2095 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-2095 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (83, 84, 85) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 235678745, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 6 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 12 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 11-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 6 min early; 11-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 4 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
